coastal.title: Coastal Jeep Safari
coastal.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey along Tenerife's dramatic southern coastline. This tour takes you through rugged volcanic landscapes, hidden beaches, and picturesque fishing villages that showcase the raw beauty of the island.
coastal.whatToExpectText: Your coastal adventure begins at the meeting point where you'll be introduced to your experienced guide and fellow adventurers. We'll travel in comfortable 4x4 vehicles along scenic coastal roads, stopping at breathtaking viewpoints and secluded beaches. You'll have time to explore, take photos, and immerse yourself in the natural beauty of Tenerife's coastline.
coastal.highlight1: Stunning ocean viewpoints along dramatic cliffs
coastal.highlight3: Hidden volcanic beaches accessible only by 4x4
coastal.info1: Please wear comfortable clothing and closed-toe shoes
coastal.info2: Bring sunscreen, sunglasses, and a hat
coastal.info3: Camera recommended for spectacular photo opportunities
coastal.info4: Not suitable for pregnant women or people with back problems

teide.title: Teide National Park Expedition
teide.description: Venture into the heart of Tenerife's volcanic wonderland with our Teide National Park tour. Explore Spain's highest peak and a UNESCO World Heritage site, featuring otherworldly landscapes, ancient lava flows, and panoramic views that will leave you breathless.
teide.whatToExpectText: This full-day expedition takes you through multiple climatic zones as we ascend to over 2,000 meters. You'll witness dramatic changes in landscape and vegetation, explore ancient volcanic formations, and enjoy lunch at a scenic spot with incredible views. Our knowledgeable guides will share fascinating geological and historical insights throughout the journey.
teide.highlight1: Mount Teide volcano - Spain's highest peak at 3,718m
teide.highlight2: Unique volcanic rock formations and lava fields
teide.info1: Warm clothing recommended - temperatures can be cool at altitude
teide.info4: Not recommended for people with altitude sensitivity

sunset.title: Sunset Safari Experience
sunset.description: Experience the magic of a Tenerife sunset from exclusive off-road locations. This evening tour combines adventure with romance as we journey to secret viewpoints where you'll witness the sun painting the sky in brilliant colors as it sets over the Atlantic Ocean.
sunset.whatToExpectText: As the day winds down, we'll take you on a scenic journey to carefully selected viewpoints that offer the most spectacular sunset vistas on the island. Along the way, you'll enjoy off-road trails through volcanic terrain, and we'll stop for refreshments as we watch the sun sink below the horizon. The tour includes time for photography and relaxation in these stunning natural settings.
sunset.highlight1: Exclusive sunset viewpoints off the beaten path
sunset.info1: Tour time varies by season to match sunset timing
sunset.info2: Bring a light jacket - evenings can be cool

about.pageSubtitle: Your trusted partner for authentic Tenerife adventures
about.storyText1: Soul Jeep Experience was born from a deep passion for Tenerife and a desire to share its hidden treasures with adventurous travelers. Founded by local guides who have spent years exploring every corner of this magnificent island, we understand that the real magic of Tenerife lies beyond the typical tourist paths.
about.storyText2: We believe that the best way to experience Tenerife is through the eyes of those who call it home. Our team of experienced guides doesn't just show you the sights - we share the stories, traditions, and secrets that make this island truly special.
about.missionText: To provide unforgettable, authentic experiences that connect travelers with the natural beauty and cultural richness of Tenerife, while maintaining the highest standards of safety and environmental responsibility.
about.value1Text: We take you to the real Tenerife, away from crowded tourist spots
about.value2Text: We protect and respect the natural environment we love
about.value3Text: Our guides are certified professionals with deep local knowledge
about.value4Text: Your safety is our top priority on every adventure
about.teamText: Our guides are not just drivers - they're storytellers, naturalists, and passionate ambassadors of Tenerife. Each brings unique expertise and a genuine love for sharing this incredible island with visitors from around the world.

faq.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know about our tours
faq.stillHaveQuestionsText: If you couldn't find the answer you're looking for, please don't hesitate to contact us. We're here to help!

faqData.q1: What should I wear on the tours?
faqData.a1: We recommend comfortable clothing suitable for outdoor activities, closed-toe shoes (hiking boots for Teide tour), and layers as temperatures can vary. Don't forget sunscreen, sunglasses, and a hat!
faqData.q2: Are the tours suitable for children?
faqData.a2: Yes! The Coastal and Sunset tours are suitable for children aged 5 and above. The Teide tour has a minimum age of 8 years due to the altitude and duration. All children must be accompanied by an adult.
faqData.q3: What happens if the weather is bad?
faqData.a3: Safety is our priority. If weather conditions are unsafe, we'll contact you to reschedule or offer a full refund. Light rain doesn't usually affect our tours, but we monitor conditions constantly.
faqData.q4: How many people are in each group?
faqData.a4: We keep our groups small and intimate, with a maximum of 6 people per vehicle. This ensures a personalized experience and allows our guides to cater to everyone's interests.
faqData.q5: Do I need to bring food and water?
faqData.a5: We provide bottled water and snacks on all tours. The Teide tour includes lunch. However, you're welcome to bring additional snacks if you prefer.
faqData.q6: Can I book a private tour?
faqData.a6: Absolutely! We offer private tours for couples, families, or groups. Contact us for custom itineraries and pricing.
faqData.a7: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the tour. Cancellations within 48 hours are subject to a 50% charge. No-shows are non-refundable.
faqData.a8: Yes, all our vehicles are fully insured and regularly maintained. We also provide insurance coverage for all participants during the tours.
faqData.a9: Yes, we offer pickup from most hotels in southern Tenerife. Specific meeting points will be confirmed when you book. There may be a small additional fee for pickups from remote locations.
faqData.q10: What languages do your guides speak?
faqData.a10: Our guides are multilingual and speak English, Spanish, Italian, French, and German. Please let us know your language preference when booking.
